QuestInfo.name: The Dilapidated Tomb
QuestInfo.0: #b#p711##k found a charm marked with #bElda#k's sign.
QuestInfo.1: #b#p711##k wants the other charms returned to #b#m010006161##k. Defeat #r60 #o63#s#k there so the charms can go back safely, then take #b#t4031141##k to #b#p712##k in #b#m010006160##k so he can read it.
QuestInfo.2: I cleared the #o63#s so the charms can go back on the tomb walls, and I gave #b#t4031141##k to #b#p712##k.

0.0: There's writing on the back of this charm, but it's in that old script. #b#p712##k is the only one who can read it.
0.1: While you take it to him, I'll get the other charms ready to go back on the tomb walls. Just one problem: the #r#o63#s#k.
0.2: They're rotten, heavy, and very territorial. Could you defeat #r60#k of them in #b#m010006161##k? The charms can't go back while they're there.

yes.0: Here's the charm. Keep it safe! Clear out the #r#o63#s#k first, then take the charm to #b#p712##k.

no.0: Fair enough. Those #o63#s are no joke. Come back when you're ready.

1.0: You cleared the tomb? Then the charms can finally go back where they belong. Thank you. Someone should have done that years ago.
1.1: And this is #bElda#k's own charm? Let me see the back...
1.2: It's a message, not a name. It's addressed to "my little ember." That must be #b#p715##k.
1.3: Give me a moment to write it out in plain words. She should hear it from you.

npc.0: Take the charm to #b#p712##k in #b#m010006160##k. And don't forget the #r#o63#s#k!

item.0: #b#p711##k found a charm with #bElda#k's mark? I don't see it with you. Ask him if it fell out of your bag.

mob.0: The #r#o63#s#k still hold the tomb. Please defeat #r60#k of them so the charms can go back on the walls.

lost.0: You dropped the charm? Lucky for you, it fell out of your bag before you left my camp.
lost.1: Here. Hold on to it this time, and take it to #b#p712##k in #b#m010006160##k.
